summary: Kudi is a student money app that splits each bit of money a student receives into six purpose purses (feeding, transport, personal needs, academic, emergency, savings), holds back savings on every income, and lets them spend only from the purse that fits. This milestone is the full working interface running on local demo data, with no wallet and no real money.
direction: Berry ink on blush paper: a warm, rounded student money app with a heavyweight serif display face (Fraunces), a friendly sans for body and tabular figures for every amount, big bento purse cards, one raspberry accent for actions and key numbers, thin berry hairlines instead of heavy shadows, and a phone-first layout with a thumb-high bottom tab bar.
